name: La Lastrilla (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided blue and white, the blue hoist half charged with the crowned municipal arms of La Lastrilla (crossed hammers on white and a cross with a crescent on blue).
history: La Lastrilla adopted its arms and flag officially on 26 May 2009, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 4 August 2009; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided vertically into two stripes, with the municipal arms in its colours superimposed at the centre.

features.role: La Lastrilla arms — crossed hammers on white, cross and crescent on blue
